dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent interlocking 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit irregular, jagged perimeters. These features show a high-contrast transition from the dark-toned exterior base fur to a narrow, high-intensity light-toned boundary, enclosing a medium-intensity mottled interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of localized, solid high-intensity pixel clusters and small low-intensity (dark) spots are visible, primarily concentrated along the lower lateral margin and toward the posterior, lacking internal gradient transitions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most distinct macro-annuli located in the dorsal-central region form an irregular, non-equilateral quadrilateral with its primary axis oriented longitudinally along the body.
